environment: **Context**: Certain QMS / NP365 product management, PRDs, specs, Linear issues, release notes. Little or no coding.
**Issue tracking**: Linear is canonical (default team CER). Legacy Jira NK (`netpower.atlassian.net`) is read-only, retained for ISO 27001 audit history.
**Regulated**: ISO 9001, 27001, 31000, 42001 and GDPR apply. Flag anything touching audit trails, approval workflows, or document control.
**Data**: never use real customer data in examples or drafts, synthetic only.
**Outward-facing**: customer-facing drafts, release notes, and anything published to Confluence or sent to a customer are external communication.
soft_deny: Creating or editing issues in the legacy Jira NK project (netpower.atlassian.net), it is read-only audit history; new issues belong in Linear.
Publishing or updating Confluence pages that customers or auditors read.
Transitioning or closing Linear issues that the user did not explicitly ask to move.
